findings.text: follow-on: _engine_running_requests duplicates the scrape-and-resolve capability the repository already owns -- imas_ambix/agent/lane.py:531 fetch_lane_capacity reads the same running-request gauge from the same /metrics origin, and imas_ambix/agent/bench.py:779 _fetch_body (imported by serving_receipts.py:393) is the shared authed GET -- so this is a fourth copy of that scrape and a second reduction over requests_running, extending only engine_metrics' name tables instead of the owner; the required max-over-ranks and absence-never-zero semantics belong beside engine_metrics.series_first so the next reader of the same quantity inherits them.
